subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same dark-haired bearded male host is clear through shots 0-3, but shots 4-5 show noticeable drift in face/body proportions and the shirt graphic changes from large teal lettering to a different green script-like mark.

background_coherent.rationale: The balcony door, bright exterior light, cream walls, wood floor, blue seating, table, and wall art remain consistent with one apartment living room/balcony area despite exposure shifts.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the medium doorway view with the host facing camera and balcony daylight visible.
Host gestures near the doorway, but the requested wider walk past the blue armchair/layout sweep is only partly evident.
Camera is closer to the balcony door and the host turns toward it, though the outside point is not very clear.
Side angle by the glass door with the host opening it and stepping toward the light fits well.
View looks back from the balcony doorway into the room, but the host gesture toward furnishings is weak in the sampled frame.
Medium shot beside the balcony door fits, though hands are raised rather than clearly lowered.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: Shots vary legitimately between selfie-style doorway views, side door interaction, and reverse view from the balcony area without collapsing into repeated framing.

motion_continuity.rationale: The sequence shows plausible progression from presenting the room, approaching the balcony door, opening it, then standing by the doorway; it is not frozen.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 3 to shot 4 introduces the clearest subject appearance and shirt-logo drift, even though the room remains coherent.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames show real viewpoint/action changes rather than copied or static shots.
